title: 第2章 这成何体统？
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【宿主，你不能这样，你这是在作弊！】

凝香还未说话，系统就爆发出一阵人机尖鸣。

“不是你说的，只要我认为对方是我的孩子，且对方愿意叫我爸爸之类的称呼，就算是有了自己的孩子吗？”

【可你这个孩子，比你还大了一岁！】

那是有些过分了哈。

张宁嫩脸一红，心底却依旧厚颜无耻，“父爱是不能被定义的，谁规定年纪小的就不能当爹了？统子哥，我这么敬重你，你不会是想耍赖吧？”

【谁耍赖，谁耍赖？我问你！】

【仅此一次，下不为例！】

【任务更正——扩张税收从先有个孩子开始：宿主的孩子，必须比宿主小十岁，且若非亲生，必须培养一年的感情方可抽奖。】

玩不起的统子哥，竟然开始补漏洞了。

不过，这也在张宁的意料之中，哪有羊毛一直被薅的？

而且，统子哥也还算仁义，没给彻底堵死。

小十岁，那就多收几个四五岁的孩子，为义子义女，然后再培养一年感情。

哥们儿别的不多，就是父爱充沛。

“统子哥，那还等啥，赶紧抽奖啊！”

系统沉默了好一会儿，才不太情愿道：“抽奖系统已开启。”

顿时，一个有着数百种品类的巨大转盘，出现在张宁的脑海中，转盘上的指针由快变慢，直至最终停了下来。

还不待张宁看清都有啥，转盘就消失不见，系统生硬的声音便响起，“恭喜宿主，获得前世豪华预制菜两份。”

尼玛，这个世界怎么也有预制菜？

上辈子就吃预制菜，这辈子居然还要吃预制菜？那我岂不是白穿越了？

不过……倒也算解了燃眉之急，就算是预制菜，都不知道比这荒山县的食物高了多少。

统子哥不会是恼怒我钻了漏子，恶意操控了抽奖的结果吧？张宁合理怀疑，但紧接着，他心头就是一动，奖品里都有预制菜了，那AK呢？

“砰！”

凝香这才反应过来，连忙跪倒在地，神色惶恐道：“殿下，您是天潢贵胄，奴婢只是一婢子而已，奴婢何德何能，与您攀亲带故？还望殿下收回成命，切莫折煞奴婢。”

“行，我收回了，起来吧。”张宁一口答应，奖励都到手了，谁还要认你做女儿啊？比我还大一岁的女儿，这像话吗？

凝香：“？？？”

啊？这就收回了？

Page (1/3)

[Host, you can't do this, you are cheating!】

Before Ningxiang could speak, the system erupted into a burst of human-machine screams.

"It's not what you said. As long as I think the other person is my child and the other person is willing to call me daddy, does it count as having a child of my own?"

[But your child is one year older than you!】

That's a little too much.

Zhang Ningnen blushed, but she was still shameless in her heart, "Father's love cannot be defined. Who said that you can't be a father if you are young? Brother Tongzi, I respect you so much, are you trying to cheat?"

[Who is cheating, who is cheating?I ask you!】

[Only this time, never happen again!】

[Mission correction - Expanding taxation starts with having a child: the host's child must be ten years younger than the host, and if it is not a biological child, it must develop a relationship for a year before it can be drawn.】

Brother Tongzi, who couldn't afford it, actually started to fix the loopholes.

However, this was also within Zhang Ning's expectation. How could anyone keep getting picked up?

Moreover, Brother Tongzi was quite benevolent and did not completely block him.

If they are ten years younger, then take in a few more four or five-year-old children as adopted sons and daughters, and then cultivate a relationship for another year.

There are not many other things about my brothers, but they are full of fatherly love.

"Brother Tongzi, what are you waiting for? Hurry up and draw the prize!"

The system was silent for a while, then reluctantly said: "The lottery system has been started."

Suddenly, a huge turntable with hundreds of categories appeared in Zhang Ning's mind. The pointer on the turntable slowed down from fast until it finally stopped.

Before Zhang Ning could see what was there, the turntable disappeared, and the system's stiff voice sounded, "Congratulations to the host, you have received two luxurious pre-made dishes from the previous life."

Damn, why are there pre-made dishes in this world?

I ate pre-prepared dishes in my last life, but I still want to eat pre-prepared dishes in this life?Then didn’t I travel through time in vain?

But...it solves an urgent need. Even the pre-made dishes are not much higher than the food in Huangshan County.

Isn't Brother Tongzi angry that I took advantage of a loophole and maliciously manipulated the results of the lottery?Zhang Ning had reasonable doubts, but then something clicked in his mind. There were pre-made dishes among the prizes. What about the AK?

"Bang!"

Only then did Ningxiang react. She quickly knelt down on the ground and said with a fearful expression: "Your Highness, you are a noble person from Tianhuang, and I am just a slave. How can I be so virtuous as to be related to you? I hope that Your Highness will take back his life and don't harm this slave."

"Okay, I'll take it back. Get up." Zhang Ning agreed. Now that the reward is in hand, who wants to recognize you as their daughter?Is this ridiculous for a daughter who is one year older than me?

Ningxiang: "???"

Huh?Is this taken back?
